title: Journey 1 — Lead → quotation → accepted → contract number (no deal)

steps.do: [Marketing Executive] Left menu → Sales → Leads → "+ New lead": Company "Flow One Fabricators", Contact, Phone, What they want, Value 6,00,000 → "Create it".
steps.expect: Lead page. "Lead L-… created." Three steps across the top: 1 Talk to them · 2 Send a quote · 3 Their answer. One main button: "📞 Log your first contact".
steps.observed: "Lead L-2026-0001 created."; steps 1 Talk to them · 2 Send a quote · 3 Their answer; main button "📞 Log your first contact".

steps.do: [Marketing Executive] "📞 Log your first contact" → fill "With whom" and a note → "Save this contact".
steps.expect: Step 1 is ticked. The main button is now "Make the quote →".
steps.observed: Step 1 ticked (✓ Talk to them); the main button is now "Make the quote →".

steps.do: [Marketing Executive] "Make the quote →".
steps.expect: New quote form with the customer, contact and subject already filled from the lead. Six parts: Client & header · Offices · Sites · Commercials · Line items · Terms.
steps.observed: New quote form: customer "Flow One Fabricators", contact "Ravi Shah", subject "Inspection of pressure vessels"; parts: Client & header · Offices · Sites · Commercials · Line items · Terms.

steps.do: [Marketing Executive] Line items: "Inspection of pressure vessels", 60 Man-day × ₹10,000 → save.
steps.expect: "Q-… created. It is saved on the lead too — Back takes you to the lead." Trail: Home › Sales › Leads › L-… · Flow One Fabricators › Quote. Totals ₹6,00,000 + GST ₹1,08,000 = ₹7,08,000.
steps.observed: "Q-00001 created. It is saved on the lead too — Back takes you to the lead."; trail Home › Sales › Leads › L-2026-0001 · Flow One Fabricators › Quote; ₹6,00,000 + GST ₹1,08,000 = ₹7,08,000.

steps.do: [Marketing Executive] "Submit for approval".
steps.expect: "Submitted for approval — 1 step(s). Now with <Marketing Manager's name> (Marketing Manager)." The top line reads "Waiting for approval — with …".
steps.observed: "Submitted for approval — 1 step(s). Now with Test MktMgr (Marketing Manager)."; top line "Waiting for approval — with Test MktMgr (Marketing Manager)."

steps.do: [Marketing Manager] Dashboard → "quotes to approve" → Quote register "Awaiting your approval" → open Q-… → "Approve".
steps.expect: "All approvals complete — quote approved and ready to send."
steps.observed: Dashboard → quotes to approve → straight to the quotation (only one is waiting, so the register is skipped) → Q-00001 → (checklist ticked) Approve → "All approvals complete — quote approved and ready to send."

steps.do: [Marketing Executive] Open the lead.
steps.expect: "Your quote Q-… is approved — ready to send to them." with "Open quote Q-… →".
steps.observed: "Your quote Q-00001 is approved — ready to send to them." with "Open quote Q-00001 →".

steps.do: [Marketing Executive] Open the quotation.
steps.expect: The top line says she sends it: "Approved and ready to go out. Next: send it to the client. Test MktExec (prepared it) sends it. The people they report to may send it if it is still unsent 24 hours after its approval — from <date, time>." The "✉ Send to client" button is there (owner, 15 Nov 2026, F1: the preparer sends). The strip at the top shows LEAD L-… and QUOTATION Q-….
steps.observed: top line: "Approved and ready to go out. Test BDM, Test KAM or Test MktMgr sends it to the client — sending is not yours to do. Tell them it is ready. Actions — move this quote: Mark lost Revise (new rev) 🧮 Project costing: ＋ Create costing for this quotation Pre-order "

steps.do: [Branch Manager, whom she reports to] Open the quotation. Then [Marketing Executive] "✉ Send to client".
steps.expect: Test BranchMgr, straight after approval: no Send button — "Test MktExec sends it first. If it is still unsent 24 hours after its approval (from …), you may send it." Test MktExec sends it: "Marked sent and follow-ups scheduled…". Top line: "Sent to the client on <date>. Waiting for their answer — mark it accepted, or lost." The page shows "🔒 Locked … raise a revision".
steps.observed: Test BranchMgr (whom the executive reports to), straight after approval: ""
steps.note: Step 9 failed, so the robot then sent Q-00001 as the administrator (sent) to check steps 10–17 independently.

steps.do: [Marketing Executive — the person the quotation is assigned to] "Mark accepted (won)".
steps.expect: "quote marked accepted. Flow One Fabricators is now linked to the client master…". Top line: "Accepted 🎉 — they said yes. With Accounts (<names>) to register the contract number. Nothing more for you to do here." (Fixed 13 Nov 2026 — it used to tell Sales "Next: register the contract number".)
steps.observed: "quote marked accepted. Flow One Fabricators has been created in the client master. Its lin…"; top line "Accepted 🎉 — they said yes. With Accounts (Test Finance) to register the contract number. Nothing more for you to do here."
steps.note: The message says "Flow One Fabricators has been created in the client master…" (it was not on the master before) rather than "is now linked to".

steps.do: [Marketing Executive] Open the lead.
steps.expect: "🎉 Won — Flow One Fabricators is now a customer." It closed by itself — nothing was pressed on the lead.
steps.observed: "🎉 Won — Flow One Fabricators is now a customer." — the lead closed by itself (CONVERTED).

steps.do: [Finance] Dashboard → "contracts to register" → open Q-….
steps.expect: An amber box: "⚠ Contract number is yet to be created — This is yours to do" with ONE button: "✓ Register the contract — next number". The playbook lower down no longer repeats a "Register contract" button.
steps.observed: Amber box "⚠ Contract number is yet to be created — This is yours to do" with one "✓ Register the contract — next number"; the playbook has no Register button.

steps.do: [Finance] "✓ Register the contract — next number".
steps.expect: One press. The number is generated (e.g. AHM/C/2026-27/00001). "Contract … registered — it is waiting for approval. Waiting for the first signature — <names>. Then the final approval — <names>. The order goes to operations once it is open." Top line: "Accepted 🎉 — contract … is waiting for approval."
steps.observed: Number AHM/C/2026-27/00001 generated in one press: "Contract AHM/C/2026-27/00001 registered — it is waiting for approval. Waiting for the first signature — Test BAM, Test BranchMgr, Test Director and 3 more. Then the final approval — Test BAM, Test BranchMgr, Test BranchMgr2. The order goes to operations once it is open."

steps.do: [Operation Manager] Dashboard → "contracts to endorse" → Contract openings → on that row "Give the first signature".
steps.expect: Stays on Contract openings. "First signature given. Waiting for the final approval — <Branch Managers by name>."
steps.observed: Stayed on Contract openings: "First signature given. Waiting for the final approval — Test BAM, Test BranchMgr, Test BranchMgr2."

steps.do: [Branch Manager] Dashboard → "contracts to approve" → on that row "Approve & open the contract".
steps.expect: Stays on Contract openings. "Contract … opened and floated to operations."
steps.observed: Stayed on Contract openings: "Contract AHM/C/2026-27/00001 opened and floated to operations."

steps.do: [Coordinator] Dashboard.
steps.expect: A task "contract opened — raise the work order" — one contract: it opens the work-order form filled in from it. "Raise a work order" lists it under "Newly opened — no work order raised yet" until its first work order is raised. (New 13 Nov 2026.)
steps.observed: Task "1 contract opened — raise the inspection call" opens the order form filled in from AHM/C/2026-27/00001 (Flow One Fabricators); /raise-call lists it under "Newly opened — no inspection call raised yet".
steps.note: Wording: in the Inspection profile a work order is called an "inspection call", so the task reads "contract opened — raise the inspection call".

steps.do: [Marketing Executive] Open the quotation.
steps.expect: Top line: "Accepted 🎉 — they said yes. Contract open — raise … from it whenever the work comes in." Contract panel: the number, "Open / in force", who asked, first signature, final approval.
steps.observed: Top line "Accepted 🎉 — they said yes. Contract open — raise … from it whenever the work comes in."; contract panel: AHM/C/2026-27/00001, Open / in force, asked by Test Finance, first signature Test OpsMgr, final approval Test BranchMgr.
steps.note: Wording slip: the top line reads "raise inspection inspection calls" (the word is doubled).

steps.do: EDGE · [Marketing Manager] Reject instead of approving, with a comment.
steps.expect: The quotation is "Sent back by …"; the preparer corrects it and presses "↻ Submit for approval again". Rejecting without a comment is refused.
steps.observed: No comment → refused ("Enter a comment saying why you are rejecting it."); with "Rate below floor" → "Rejected. The quote now shows as rejected by you, with your "; the preparer sees "Sent back by Test MktMgr." and "↻ Submit for approval again".

steps.do: EDGE · [Finance] Open the quotation BEFORE it is accepted.
steps.expect: No registration is offered anywhere: the step reads "Register the contract number — Comes after it is accepted." and has no button. (Before 13 Nov 2026 a draft showed a "Register contract" button that led nowhere.)
steps.observed: "Register the contract number — Comes after it is accepted." and no Register button.

steps.do: EDGE · [Finance] The client already has another contract.
steps.expect: The amber box shows "See the registration panel" instead of the one-press button — the panel lists the client's contracts so a second one is not added by mistake.
steps.observed: No one-press button; the amber box links "Register it now" to the registration panel, which lists the client's contract AHM/C/2026-27/00001.
steps.note: For Finance the amber box's link reads "Register it now" (it is "See the registration panel" for people who may not register) — it opens the panel, which lists AHM/C/2026-27/00001.
steps.suggest: The amber box shows "Register it now" (to the registration panel) instead of the one-press button; the panel lists the client's contracts.

steps.do: EDGE · [Operation Manager] Try to open the quotation itself.
steps.expect: "Sales & CRM — restricted" — an Operation Manager signs from Contract openings and does not need the quotation.
steps.observed: "Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission to open CRM — Quotations. Ask your work"

steps.do: EDGE · [Branch Manager] Open Contract openings BEFORE the first signature.
steps.expect: No main button on that row: "Waiting for the first signature — …" and "You give the final approval, after the first signature." (SAL-179).
steps.observed: Row AHM/C/2026-27/00002: no main button; "Waiting for the first signature — forward to (optional) — · coordinator · asst manager · branch app manager · branch manager · business director · operation man…"

steps.do: EDGE · The customer says no.
steps.expect: "Mark lost" on the quotation, with a reason → the quotation closes as lost.
steps.observed: "Mark lost" with a reason → LOST (PRICE_HIGH): "Quotation moved to Lost / regretted."

steps.do: EDGE · The company's contract rule is "One approval" or "None".
steps.expect: One: only the final approval is asked. None: the contract is open the moment Accounts registers it (SAL-178, SAL-179).
steps.observed: One approval: the Operation Manager is asked nothing ((not listed)), the Branch Manager's single Approve opens it; None: the contract is OPEN the moment it is registered.

steps.do: EDGE · The price must change after it was sent.
steps.expect: "Raise a revision" — same quote number, next revision, approved and sent again; its costing stays linked (SAL-177).
steps.observed: Revision Q-00009 Rev 01 (same number) raised from the sent quotation, approved by Test MktMgr and sent again.
steps.note: The costing part ("its costing stays linked", SAL-177) was not exercised here — this man-day quotation has no costing.
